Definition: {perhaps properly, to be plump, i.e. (transitively) to nourish}
BiblicalUsage: Zuwn is the Aramaic word for feeding — in Nebuchadnezzar's dream the great tree fed all flesh, its leaves fair and its fruit much, and all living things found food under it. One verse, one tree, and the whole world fed from it until the tree was cut down.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the tree fed everyone because God provides for all, and its fall shows that provision itself rests in His hand.
